pixel_convention: x to the right, y downward, origin top-left, full-resolution pixels
frame_duplicate: frame 1 is an exact copy of frame 0 (mean |diff| 0.02): every object shows zero displacement 0->1. From frame 1 on every frame differs.

camera.motion: static (sky/background residual < 0.05 grey levels over the clip; parked cars shift <= 0.5 px by phase correlation)
camera.vanishing_point_note: intersection of the two curbs of the main road that runs away from the camera: left curb through (0,1036) and (825,817); right curb through (1563,817) and (2160,1042). Read at 0.8x zoom, about +-15 px. VP x = 1258 is right of the image centre (1080), so the camera looks slightly left of the road direction.
camera.horizon_note: far end of the road / horizon at y ~ 700-712. It is below the image centre (540), so the camera is pitched down.
camera.cross_street: a street crossing left to right at mid-distance. The van and cyclist move along it at almost constant image y (van tyre contact y ~ 799, cyclist wheel bottom y ~ 801), so that street is nearly parallel to the image x axis. The van's apparent length grows a little as it moves right (its rear face comes into view).

taxi.description: yellow NYC-style taxi with a roof sign. Starts on the cross street at left, side view, heading right, behind the pedestrian. Turns right into the main road toward the camera and ends front-on at x~870-1050 in the camera's lane area.
taxi.reference_point: cx, cy = bbox centre. The vehicle root is not visible: use the bbox centre or the bottom centre (cx, y_max) on the ground.
taxi.apparent_size_px: side view f5-25: length ~300, height ~90. Turning f25-49: bbox width shrinks to ~131 (front-on, f47-53). Then front-on width grows 131 -> 181 and height 110 -> 128 by f71 as it approaches. Bottom (tyres) y: 807 (f0) -> 826 (f36) -> 852 (f71).

van.description: white cargo van with two brown rectangular side panels. Drives left -> right along the cross street, behind the taxi and the cyclist and in front of the green car.
van.reference_point: cx, cy = bbox centre. patch_cx (centre of the two brown side panels, sub-pixel template match) is the most precise x-motion signal (+-0.3 px).
van.apparent_size_px: length (rear to front bumper) ~296-303 px over f0-60, growing to 316 at f71 (rear face visible). Height ~108 px (roof y~692, tyre contact y~799), constant within ~2 px.

cyclist.description: rider in dark navy top and jeans on a silver/white bicycle. Crosses left -> right along the cross street at constant pace, between the taxi (in front of him early) and the van (behind him late).
cyclist.reference_point: rider_cx/cy = head+torso template centre (precise, +-0.5 px). pelvis_x_est/pelvis_y_est = hip/saddle estimate (+-4 px). cx/cy = bbox centre.
cyclist.apparent_size_px: bbox (rear wheel to front wheel x head top to wheel bottom) ~92 x 88 px, constant (measured on clean frames 33-36, checked at f55, f64, f71).

pedestrian.description: man in a white T-shirt and light-blue jeans on the left sidewalk (x ~510-630). Stands almost still at the start, then walks toward the camera and to the left.
pedestrian.reference_point: cx = body axis x. pelvis_x_est/pelvis_y_est = pelvis estimate. head_top measured every frame. The feet are behind the garbage bags from frame ~25 on.
pedestrian.apparent_size_px: standing height head-top -> soles ~110 px (head top ~706, soles ~815) for frames 0-24. Body width incl. arms ~44 px. Head top stays at 706-709 all clip. The bottom is hidden later, so the later growth is not measured.

maroon_sedan.description: dark maroon/purple sedan, rear facing the camera, parked in the main road right of centre (closer than the green car)

green_car.description: small dark-green/white car (BMW-like), front facing the camera, far down the main road just left of centre

trash_can.description: silver metal trash can standing on the road, near the bottom right of centre

garbage_bags.description: pile of black/grey garbage bags (three bags) in the left foreground on the road/curb

green_bin.description: dark-green slatted litter bin on the left sidewalk next to a lamp post

lamp_posts.description: ornate double-lantern street lamps on both sidewalks
lamp_posts.note: positions read at 0.8x zoom, +-5 px; a long row of smaller lamps continues down both sides of the road

road_and_sidewalks.description: grey asphalt main road running away from the camera with beige sidewalks on both sides; a cross street at mid-distance (y ~700-800); red-brown tree pits / planters on the sidewalks (e.g. right sidewalk x 1890-2100, y ~810-830)

events.event: van at rest at frames 0-1. It starts moving between frames 1 and 2 and then speeds up smoothly to the end (patch shift 0.8 px/frame at f1->2, ~26.5 px/frame at f70->71)
cyclist moving at a steady ~11.9 px/frame to the right from the first real frame change (f1->2) to the end
taxi moving to the right on the cross street from the start, ~6-7 px/frame image-x (bbox centre is jittery early: +-6 px)
pedestrian starts nearly still (~0.2-0.3 px/frame) and gradually speeds up to ~1.5 px/frame by f16-20. Then walks steadily left (and toward the camera) at ~1.0-1.4 px/frame
cyclist comes out from behind the taxi's front (fully visible from f28)
taxi turns toward the camera: bbox width shrinks 290 -> 131 px
taxi image-x motion reverses: it moves right up to ~f45, then slowly left. From here it heads toward the camera (tyre-contact y rises ~1 px/frame to the end)
cyclist passes in front of the static green car
cyclist's bike and legs hidden behind the static maroon sedan; head and torso visible above it
van front passes the cyclist's centre in image x: the van overtakes the cyclist behind him (cyclist in front)
clip end. All four moving objects still in view

tracks_columns.common: frame, time, x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max (bbox, px), cx, cy (bbox centre or body axis), occluded_by (front objects overlapping >=5% of bbox)
tracks_columns.van.csv: patch_cx (brown side panels centre), length_px, height_px, rear_raw/front_raw (directly measured ends where clean)
tracks_columns.pedestrian.csv: centre_x/centre_y (template), pelvis_x_est/pelvis_y_est, head_top, feet_y (visible frames only), height_px (frames 0-24), template_score, occlusion text
